name: Rate-Distortion Optimization Loss
aliases: L2 loss between rendered and ground truth colors
definition: The first term is the L2 loss between the image rendered by NeRF and the ground truth image, indicating distortion level.
summary: Rate-Distortion Optimization Loss balances photometric accuracy against representation efficiency by adding rate and regularization terms to standard NeRF training, explicitly controlling the trade-off between image quality and bitrate for compression.
